plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate leveraged ETF exposure. Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet mandate. Add to QQQI, increasing it to 25% for income and broad index exposure. Buy NET at 5% as a top-quality scanner setup.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets capital preservation with a potential return of ~1.5% per month. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration, but also limits upside potential.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 1% to reduce leveraged ETF exposure. Trim SPY to 25% to reduce concentration and meet mandate. Add KTOS at 4% and NET at 4% as quality tech scanner setups.
balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for risk-first growth, targeting ~2.5% per month. It balances broad index exposure with quality tech, maintaining some leverage for growth while managing overall risk.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to reduce concentration and meet mandate. Add to SOXL and SPAL, increasing each to 6% to lean into leveraged ETFs. Add KTOS and NET, each to 6%, concentrating in high-scoring scanner setups.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets stretch growth, aiming for ~4% per month. It significantly increases both upside and drawdown potential due to higher leverage and concentration in volatile assets. Leveraged ETFs decay daily, and this mode can lead to substantial losses if stops are not strictly adhered to.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure. Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet mandate. Add to QQQI, increasing it to 30% to prioritize income and distributions. Add to QQQ, increasing it to 25% for broad index stability.
